Class McpPlanInstallRequest

java.lang.Object
com.github.copilot.generated.rpc.McpPlanInstallRequest
@CopilotExperimental @Generated("copilot-sdk-codegen") public final class McpPlanInstallRequest extends Object
A side-effect-free request for an MCP install plan. Computing a plan never writes configuration, stores a secret, or reloads MCP servers.

Required inputs are constructor arguments. Optional inputs have fluent setters.

Since:
1.0.0
